The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 白蘞 (báiliǎn), flavor bitter, neutral and slightly cold. It governs carbuncle swelling and carbuncle sores (癰腫疽瘡), disperses bound qi (散結氣), stops pain and removes heat (止痛除熱), redness of the eyes (目中赤), fright-epilepsy and warm malaria in children (小兒驚癇溫瘧), and the genitals of women (女子陰)...
